items.title: Suno boss talks streaming fraud: 'AI music is not a crime'
items.excerpt: Suno CEO Mikey Shulman criticised the 'sleight of hand' of equating streaming fraud with AI music, and said Suno is doing more behind the scenes to tackle fraud than people realise.

items.title: Reservoir Expands Its Suno and Anthropic Suits, Seeking $450M
items.excerpt: Reservoir amended its copyright and DMCA lawsuits against Suno and Anthropic to cover more than 2,500 songs combined, with sought damages now approaching $450 million.

items.title: You can now vibe code plugins for your MPC with the help of Akai's official SDK
items.excerpt: Akai's latest MPC, MPC Sample and Force updates ship an official SDK so users can build custom synths and effects for standalone hardware, explicitly pitched as vibe-codable with AI coding assistants.

items.title: 50 Cent Trolls Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's Affair With 'P.I.M.P.' Music Video AI Deepfake
items.excerpt: 50 Cent posted an AI deepfake remake of his 'P.I.M.P.' music video starring former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, the latest high-profile artist use of generative video for a music clip.

items.title: AI-powered label PaRa Music says it's identified the next big Indian regional music sub-genre
items.excerpt: Indian label PaRa Music uses its in-house AI platform PaRaMeter to analyse audience behaviour and demand patterns to guide A&R investment, and now claims it has spotted the next regional sub-genre.

items.title: AI 노래가 전화 화면까지 들어온다…민티파이 운영사 뮤직플랫, V 컬러링 서비스 시작
items.excerpt: AI 음원 유통 서비스 민티파이(뮤직플랫)가 통신 3사의 통화 연결 영상 서비스 V 컬러링·V 프로필에 AI로 만든 노래를 공급하기 시작했다.

items.title: Highlights, concerns, and trends from Game Sound Con 2026
items.excerpt: MusicTech's report from the game music and sound conference, where generative AI in game audio and scoring was a central concern and trend.

items.title: “An affront to any songwriter”: Nick Cave on AI song-generating platforms
items.excerpt: Nick Cave calls AI song generators 'our final, most soul-destroying humiliation' and an affront to songwriters who earned the right to create a song.

items.title: The 'Blue Wave' Could Change the Rules for Music AI
items.excerpt: After the US midterm 'Blue Wave', DMN maps how a new Congress could move AI music reforms on artist rights, copyright and compensation.

items.title: Carmine Appice On Using AI To Create Cactus Music Videos
items.excerpt: Rock drummer Carmine Appice explains how AI video is driving the music videos for Cactus's recent albums.

items.title: Can Music Generation Models Tap Along? Evaluating Generative Approaches to Beat Tracking
items.excerpt: Researchers add an audio-conditioning adapter to a pretrained MusicGen model so it generates percussion tracks synchronized to an input song, then extract beat positions from them.

items.title: Ex-bandmates Dr Dre and Ice Cube clash over the use of AI
items.excerpt: On Ice Cube's new podcast, Dr Dre called AI 'a whole new level of creativity' producers must adopt or be left behind; Ice Cube pushed back.

items.title: AI로 선율 입힌 셰익스피어詩…용호성 前차관, 첫 정규앨범 발표
items.excerpt: AI를 활용한 음악을 선보여 온 용호성 전 문체부 차관이 예명 '닥터 드래곤'으로 셰익스피어 시에 AI로 선율을 입힌 첫 정규앨범을 냈다.

items.title: Evaluating AI Musical Creativity: A Quantitative Multi-Dimensional Framework Based on Value, Novelty, and Surprise
items.excerpt: A framework that operationalizes Boden's value, novelty and surprise to quantitatively evaluate the creativity of AI-generated music.

items.title: Backlash Already Rumbles Against Spotify's Upcoming Remix Tool
items.excerpt: Spotify's upcoming AI remix tool is drawing criticism from listeners and artists questioning fairness to artists and the ethics of its AI training.

items.title: Logic Pro 13 gets touch right, but stumbles on "intelligent assistant"
items.excerpt: CDM's hands-on finds Logic Pro 13's touch upgrades strong but its AI 'intelligent assistant' that opens plugins, creates tracks and adjusts levels on command falls short.

items.title: 듀스, 31년 만에 정규 4집…故 김성재 목소리 AI로 구현
items.excerpt: 그룹 듀스가 21일 31년 만의 정규 4집을 내며, 故 김성재의 목소리를 AI로 구현해 '완전체' 앨범을 완성했다.

items.title: Music Inpainting With Similarity-Guided Latent Diffusion
items.excerpt: SimDPS retrieves contextually similar segments from a recording and uses them to guide a diffusion model to replace large missing or damaged sections of music audio; model-agnostic across waveform and latent diffusion.
